hero.title: Your health,
hero.description: A fast, accurate, and confidential symptom analysis to guide you to the right care. Advanced medical technology, simplified interface for everyone.

features.title: A rigorous medical approach combined with the power of AI.

analysis.title: Intelligent Analysis
analysis.description: Our algorithms are trained on millions of validated clinical cases to offer maximum accuracy in identifying pathologies.

evolution.title: Evolution Tracking
evolution.description: Do not face your symptoms alone. DiagnoCare ensures regular follow-up to detect any worsening or complication.

confidentiality.title: Total Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Your health data is encrypted end-to-end. It never leaves your device without your explicit consent.

how_it_works.title: A simple 4-step path to take care of you.

describe.title: 1. Describe
describe.description: Enter your symptoms in natural language or via our guided list.

analyze.title: 2. Analyze
analyze.description: Our AI compares your profile to thousands of similar cases instantly.

understand.title: 3. Understand
understand.description: Receive a detailed report with probable causes and advice.

consult.title: 4. Consult
consult.description: Get referred to the right specialist with a medical summary ready.

faq.title: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.question: Is this a medical diagnosis?
items.answer: DiagnoCare provides decision support to guide your care, but does not replace the advice of a healthcare professional.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. All information is encrypted and does not leave your device without your explicit consent.

items.question: How does the AI work?
items.answer: Our AI compares your symptoms to thousands of validated cases to propose precise diagnostic hypotheses.

items.question: Can I share the results with my doctor?
items.answer: You can export a summary of your evaluation and easily send it to your doctor.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: The application offers a 100% free basic version, though the introduction of premium features is not ruled out.

cta.category: Ready to take charge of your health?
cta.title: Join the thousands of patients who use DiagnoCare.
cta.description: Improve your understanding of symptoms and get personalized recommendations today.
cta.warning_text: DiagnoCare is a decision support tool and does not replace professional medical advice. This is not a medical diagnosis. In case of emergency, contact emergency services immediately.
